description: Pack-local Evidence types for EV depot behind-the-meter commissioning (EVSE/depot integration facts not covered by bess-commissioning).

types.description: Field walkdown records working clearances, labels, and battery/charger enclosure coordination for the depot layout.
Charger controller telemetry or commissioning tool confirms the command/status loop is online for the tested EVSE group.
E-stop or interlock actuation is observed by the charger controller/safety relay path, not only signed off verbally.
Charger load-step request is served while BESS voltage and thermal evidence remain in band.
